reports.title: Bangladesh vs South Africa · 1st Test · Day 2

score.note: South Africa ended Day 2 on 287/4, 113 runs behind Bangladesh's first-innings total.

performances.note: Anchored Bangladesh's recovery after the top order fell to 22/3.
Shared a 206-run sixth-wicket partnership with Hridoy.
Took five wickets in Bangladesh's first innings.
Removed four batters as Bangladesh were dismissed for 400.
Built a 202-run second-wicket stand with Ackerman.
Led Bangladesh's wicket-taking at the close of Day 2.

analysis.bangladesh: 400 is a strong first-innings total after a precarious 22/3 start. Hridoy and Litton's 206-run stand was the defining partnership. Bangladesh's bowlers then struggled to contain the scoring once Ackerman and Hamza settled.
analysis.south_africa: South Africa's reply was driven by Ackerman and Hamza, whose 202-run partnership shifted the momentum. At 287/4 they remained 113 behind at stumps, so the innings was competitive but not yet ahead.
analysis.tactical: Bangladesh's first priority on Day 3 is to break the remaining partnerships quickly and keep the deficit intact. They need disciplined lines and sustained pressure rather than predictable short-ball attacks. South Africa will look to convert this platform into a first-innings lead.
analysis.assessment: Competitive Test with South Africa holding the momentum at Day 2 stumps, while Bangladesh still have a 113-run lead. The next session is pivotal. No win probability is assigned because this project does not yet have a validated predictive model.
